name: hosts-redirect-linux
description: Practice-box misconfiguration: appends a line to /etc/hosts that redirects update/relay hostnames to an attacker IP (DNS poisoning without touching DNS). Idempotent. Vars: IP (required); HOSTS (required, space-separated hostnames).
script:
#!/bin/sh
set -eu
: "${IP:?IP is required}"
: "${HOSTS:?HOSTS is required}"
line="$IP   $HOSTS"
grep -qF "$line" /etc/hosts || printf '%s\n' "$line" >> /etc/hosts
